The '''Trailblazers''' was a squad of six [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] who were armed with [[Knife/Legends|knives]] and [[Spear/Legends|spears]]. They participated in the [[Skirmish on Endor (Recon-A)|Skirmish on Endor]] alongside with [[Recon-A]].
